learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basics of modeling and the concept of the Finite Element Method.
They can independently learn to use modern Finite Element programs.
They can perform basic design calculations for digital twins using the programs.
They are able to interpret and critically evaluate existing Finite Element calculation results.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental equations of FEM and numerical procedures based on planar bar elements (40%)
Continuum elements using the example of simple plate elements (20%)
Rules for creating good Finite Element models (10%)
Computer exercises with simple examples: Use of FEM programs in structural mechanics and generation of good FEM models (30%)
Bearing conditions and load assumptions in statics (30%)
Different model types and their associated finite elements (20%)
Interpretation and verification of calculation results (20%)
teaching_methods: Lab with computer exercises using an FEM program
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a graded written exam (MABB341 Klausur, 60 min) and an ungraded lab report (MABB342 XS Laborbericht, 1 semester).
bibliography: Own script and the sources cited therein
